findings.quote: the response has twice the centered variation of the predictor
findings.issue: Variation can be read as variance; the displayed variances are 68 and 17, so variance is four times, while centered deviations and standard deviation double.
findings.replacement: The relation is exactly $y_i=2x_i+3$, so each centered response is twice its corresponding centered predictor. The response standard deviation doubles, and its variance is four times the predictor variance.
